digest.component_or_area: pytest fixture teardown, snapshot cache cleanup
propositions: Snapshot cache directories at .rebar/run_snapshots are published with read-only permissions (0444/0555) and survive pytest basetemp teardown when snapshot producers exist in modules other than test_snapshot.py
Cleanup responsibility was owned only by a module-local fixture in test_snapshot.py, leaving non-removable read-only snapshot trees in basetemp when snapshots are created by cross-module test modules
The existing snapshot._rmtree_writable seam successfully removes read-only snapshot directories by restoring write permissions, while ordinary shutil.rmtree fails with PermissionError

Shared teardown in tests/conftest.py must centrally remove all .rebar/run_snapshots roots below test-owned tmp_path using snapshot._rmtree_writable while preserving adjacent temporary content and production snapshot read-only behavior
